Pulse AI connects our Pulse Analytics suite to AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, for integration into your existing workflow. Its Pre-Trade capabilities are now live for global futures, with equities arriving in October. With it, traders and portfolio managers can optimize trading costs and study liquidity characteristics using BestEx Research's proprietary market impact cost model and realized and estimated intraday volume, volatility, spread, and more. Broker-neutral post-trade cost analytics is an entirely new offering, arriving in Q1 2027 and accessible via Pulse AI. Users will be able to measure, optimize, and report trading outcomes from overall performance and broker comparison to execution quality and venue selection, building actionable scorecards in minutes.
